target.title: docs: add ClawHub glossary labels
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Adds missing zh-CN glossary entries for existing ClawHub documentation titles so generated localized docs can keep those labels stable.

AI-assisted: yes.

## Why This Change Was Made

The branch preserves the existing ClawHub mirrored navigation contract and only adds glossary labels for the existing `ClawHub CLI` and `Publishing on ClawHub` titles. It does not add local OpenClaw-owned ClawHub pages or remove any mirror-owned ClawHub routes.

## User Impact

Readers of localized docs get consistent ClawHub labels while the published ClawHub docs navigation continues to expose the routes supplied by the ClawHub mirror.

- Final diff against that base: `docs/.i18n/glossary.zh-CN.json` only, 8 insertions.
